import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 510;
    static int mod;
    static int[] fact_array = new int[maxn];
    static int[] inv_fact_array = new int[maxn];
    static int[] invs_array = new int[maxn];
    static int[] fct_arr = new int[maxn];
    static int[] cst_arr = new int[maxn];
    static int[][] dp1_alt = new int[maxn][maxn];
    static int[][] dp2_alt = new int[maxn][maxn];

    static long total_pairs_sum(int x) {
        return (long) x * (x + 1) / 2;
    }

    static void precompute() {
        fact_array[0] = 1;
        fact_array[1] = 1;
        invs_array[1] = 1;
        inv_fact_array[0] = 1;
        inv_fact_array[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i < maxn; i++) {
            fact_array[i] = (int) ((1L * fact_array[i - 1] * i) % mod);
            invs_array[i] = mod - (int) ((1L * (mod / i) * invs_array[mod % i]) % mod);
            inv_fact_array[i] = (int) ((1L * inv_fact_array[i - 1] * invs_array[i]) % mod);
        }
    }

    static int choose(int a, int b) {
        return (int) ((1L * fact_array[a] * ((1L * inv_fact_array[b] * inv_fact_array[a - b]) % mod)) % mod);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();

        precompute();

        fct_arr[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            fct_arr[i] = 0;
            cst_arr[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int temp1 = (int) ((1L * choose(i - 1, j) * fct_arr[j]) % mod);
                int temp2 = (int) ((1L * choose(i - 1, j) * fct_arr[j]) % mod);
                int temp3 = (int) ((1L * choose(i - 1, j) * fct_arr[j]) % mod);
                int temp4 = (int) ((1L * choose(i - 1, j) * fct_arr[j]) % mod);

                long val1 = (1L * temp1 * fct_arr[i - 1 - j]) % mod;
                long val2 = (1L * (i + 1) * choose(i - 1, j)) % mod;
                long val3 = (1L * (total_pairs_sum(j) + total_pairs_sum(i - 1 - j))) % mod;
                long val4 = (1L * fct_arr[j] * cst_arr[i - 1 - j]) % mod;
                long val5 = (1L * fct_arr[i - 1 - j] * cst_arr[j]) % mod;

                fct_arr[i] = (int) ((fct_arr[i] + val1 * fct_arr[i - 1 - j]) % mod);
                cst_arr[i] = (int) ((cst_arr[i] + val2 * (val4 + val5) + val3 * val1) % mod);
            }
            fct_arr[i] = (int) ((1L * fct_arr[i] * (i + 1)) % mod);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < maxn; j++) {
                dp1_alt[i][j] = 0;
                dp2_alt[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }

        dp1_alt[0][0] = 1;
        for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
            dp1_alt[k][0] = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= Math.min(m, k); i++) {
                dp1_alt[k][i] = dp1_alt[k - 1][i];
                dp2_alt[k][i] = dp2_alt[k - 1][i];
                for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                    int val1 = (int) ((1L * fct_arr[j] * dp1_alt[Math.max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod);
                    int val2 = (int) ((1L * cst_arr[j] * dp1_alt[Math.max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod);
                    int val3 = (int) ((1L * fct_arr[j] * dp2_alt[Math.max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod);
                    int chooseVal = choose(i, j);

                    dp1_alt[k][i] = (dp1_alt[k][i] + (int) ((1L * val1 * chooseVal) % mod)) % mod;
                    dp2_alt[k][i] = (dp2_alt[k][i] + (int) ((1L * val2 * chooseVal) % mod)) % mod;
                    dp2_alt[k][i] = (dp2_alt[k][i] + (int) ((1L * val3 * chooseVal) % mod)) % mod;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dp2_alt[n][m]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
